bad_cell: known block, parse_ok=false, null value and field_unknown[field]=parse_cell; absent provider field is not_reported
clock: source host receipt minus its stored finite clock_offset_s; compare with sheet_as_of; no implicit zero offset
label: provider_claim
numeric: finite signed percent; nonnegative USD/counts; K/M/B suffixes and comma thousands; count must resolve to integer
pumpfun: only explicit vol_24h_usd/volume_24h, change_24h_pct/price_change_24h, holders, holders_total, market_cap_usd/usd_market_cap; market_cap is not USD
selection: feed/filter listed this coin using these provider cells; feed-specific descriptive evidence
source: exact ticket intake row, poll and candidate identities bound; never latest-row substitution
